en.before: Disclosure of AI-assisted method is not yet a requirement of any standard an internal auditor works to. ISO 19011:2026 requires - or rather, recommends, since it states guidance - that the report provide a complete, accurate, concise and clear record of the audit. Whether that includes naming the tools is a matter of judgement today.
en.after: Disclosure of AI-assisted method is not yet a requirement of any standard an internal auditor works to. ISO 19011:2026 requires - or rather, recommends, since it states guidance - that the report be a complete, accurate, concise and clear record of what was done. Whether that includes naming the tools is a matter of judgement today.
